flags.message: The provisioned application.txt (44 pages, fetched 2026-10-03) carries empty_text: true, so the application's text was unavailable and the ask was read from the single docket entry ('Application (26A449) for a stay, submitted to Justice Alito'). The forecast rests on the docket skeleton, the applicant's public litigation history on CourtListener, and the statpack baseline, not on the filing's content.

CourtListener MCP calls began returning HTTP 429 (shared 300/hour limit, ~8 minutes to reset) after eight successful calls, so the underlying N.D. Tex. docket (Holloway v. Polk, 4:25-cv-01128) and the 2026 Waco court of appeals opinion were located but not read. The cell proceeded on the provisioned inputs plus the search results already returned.
